answer: A bond of 47% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in tundra, and basalt reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 183 aliases, and each one needs its own funded trellis account. Scaling to 154 identities multiplies that fee by 673 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
